description: Apply a JSON Patch (RFC 6902: add, remove, replace, move, copy, test) or a JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7386) to a JSON document and return the result. Atomic: any failing operation or test returns 422 with the operation index and nothing is applied. POST JSON body {document, patch}. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/json-patch

patch.description: RFC 6902 operations array, or an object = RFC 7386 merge patch

name: json_patch
title: Json Patch
